verified_equations.1_2_factor_fusion: Three mapped log-softmax terms are weighted, summed, class-centered, and clipped once in [-6,0]. Mobile training and inference ordinary-query correction; Pano supervision only.
verified_equations.3_normalization: Query and prototype L2 normalization; epsilon 1e-12.
verified_equations.4_prototype_scores: LogSumExp across four cosine scores divided by temperature; no division by prototype count or subtraction of log(4).
verified_equations.5_prototype_loss: Mean matched final-layer class CE, lambda 0.03 Mobile and 0.05 Pano; no inference logit fusion.
verified_equations.6_7_prior_statistics: Normalized centers and joint log normalized width/height. Full sample covariance + 1e-3 I.
verified_equations.8_9_prior_score: Minus one-half Mahalanobis quadratic form clipped [-20,0], then centered across classes and separately clipped [-6,0].
verified_equations.10_prior_combination: Added in logit space with weights .20 center/.05 shape/.20 view before sigmoid and flattened query-class top-300. For panorama, view term is identically zero.
